dialogues.jp: ４月８日――月曜日。
dialogues.en: April 8th... Monday.
dialogues.text: April 8th... Monday.

dialogues.jp: 春。
dialogues.en: Spring.
dialogues.text: Spring.

dialogues.jp: 新学期。
dialogues.en: A new semester.
dialogues.text: A new semester.

dialogues.jp: 空は高く、青く。
dialogues.en: The sky is vast and blue.
dialogues.text: The sky is vast and blue.

dialogues.jp:
風は緻密に計算されたかのように気持ちの良い
間隔で頬をなでる。
dialogues.en: The wind feels comfortably warm on my cheeks.
dialogues.text: The wind feels comfortably warm on my cheeks.

dialogues.jp: うぐいすの鳴き声が遠くから聞こえた。
dialogues.en: I hear a nightingale in the distance.
dialogues.text: I hear a nightingale in the distance.

dialogues.jp: そんな、うららかな月曜日の朝。
dialogues.en: On a peaceful Monday morning.
dialogues.text: On a peaceful Monday morning.

dialogues.jp:
「ついにこの恐れた日がやってきてしまったか
　……」
dialogues.en: "The day I've been dreading has finally come..."
dialogues.text: "The day I've been dreading has finally come..."

dialogues.jp: 素直に眠かった。
dialogues.en: I was dead tired.
dialogues.text: I was dead tired.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい」
dialogues.en: "Here you go."
dialogues.text: "Here you go."

dialogues.jp:
ぴっ、と俺の制服の｛えり／襟｝を正しながら、音夢がた
め息をつく。
dialogues.en: Nemu sighs, fixing the collar of my uniform.
dialogues.text: Nemu sighs, fixing the collar of my uniform.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「普通に学校に行って勉強するだけでしょうが」
dialogues.en: "You just go and study there just like you used to."
dialogues.text: "You just go and study there just like you used to."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それが嫌なんだろうが……夏休みが早く来な
　いかなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"That's what I've been dreading. I can't wait until the
summer break."
dialogues.text:
"That's what I've been dreading. I can't wait until the
summer break."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あのね……けほっ……ハンカチとティッシュ
　は持った？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, come on... (cough)... Do you have a handkerchief and
some tissues?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, come on... (cough)... Do you have a handkerchief and
some tissues?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「多分」
dialogues.en: "Probably."
dialogues.text: "Probably."

dialogues.jp: ごそごそ、とポケットを確認する。
dialogues.en: I check inside my pocket.
dialogues.text: I check inside my pocket.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「準備オッケー？」
dialogues.en: "Are you ready to go?"
dialogues.text: "Are you ready to go?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「永遠に心の準備は出来ないと思うがな」
dialogues.en: "I don't think I will ever be ready for that."
dialogues.text: "I don't think I will ever be ready for that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい。授業中は携帯の音を切っておくん
　だよ。あと、もう杉並くんと変なことしたら
　ダメだからね？」
dialogues.en:
"Fine, fine. Don't forget to turn off your cell phone in
class, and don't even think about doing something naughty
with Suginami."
dialogues.text:
"Fine, fine. Don't forget to turn off your cell phone in
class, and don't even think about doing something naughty
with Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だから、俺とアレを一緒にするなっての。そ
　れに……あ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, don't treat me like I'm the same as him. And..."
dialogues.text: "Hey, don't treat me like I'm the same as him. And..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp: 思わず口が滑ってしまった。
dialogues.en: It slipped out of my mouth.
dialogues.text: It slipped out of my mouth.

dialogues.jp:
「あいつと同じクラスになるとは限らないし
　……と」
dialogues.en: "There's no guarantee we'll be in the same class."
dialogues.text: "There's no guarantee we'll be in the same class."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん、そうだね」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, that's true."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, that's true."

dialogues.jp:
自分にも同じことがいえる音夢が、ちょっと寂
しそうに微笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiles sadly since it could happen to her, too.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiles sadly since it could happen to her, too.

dialogues.jp: 「すまない」
dialogues.en: "Sorry."
dialogues.text: "Sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんの……けほけほ……ん！」
dialogues.en: "Brother... (cough)...!"
dialogues.text: "Brother... (cough)...!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「無理しないで家に入ってろって。見送りされ
　ると恥ずかしいしな」
dialogues.en:
"Go inside and take it easy. I'll get embarrassed if you
send me off here."
dialogues.text:
"Go inside and take it easy. I'll get embarrassed if you
send me off here."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん……ごめんね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, sorry."
dialogues.text: "Oh, sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「謝るなよ。とりあえず、お前の分まで学園で
　寝てきてやるから」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry. Anyway I'll get lots of sleep at school, even
enough for you too."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry. Anyway I'll get lots of sleep at school, even
enough for you too."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「勉強してらっしゃい！」
dialogues.en: "You've got to study!"
dialogues.text: "You've got to study!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったりぃなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Geez... What a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text: "Geez... What a pain in the neck."

dialogues.jp: 頭をかいてとぼとぼと歩き出す。
dialogues.en: I start to plod along, scratching my head.
dialogues.text: I start to plod along, scratching my head.

dialogues.jp: ……我ながらなんて歩き方だ。
dialogues.en: What a weird walk I do!
dialogues.text: What a weird walk I do!

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、兄さん兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, brother!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, brother!"

dialogues.jp: ぐい、と制服をひっぱられる。
dialogues.en: She pulled me by my uniform.
dialogues.text: She pulled me by my uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「日課がまだだよ」
dialogues.en: "You haven't done the morning ritual yet."
dialogues.text: "You haven't done the morning ritual yet."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「医者のお墨付きでお前は病気だよ」
dialogues.en: "You're sick enough to be certified by a doctor."
dialogues.text: "You're sick enough to be certified by a doctor."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「家にひとりにさせておくのに、心配じゃない
　の？」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you worried to leave me alone at home?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you worried to leave me alone at home?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hm."
dialogues.text: "Hm."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Teehee!"
dialogues.text: "Teehee!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……気持ち悪いやつ」
dialogues.en: "Creepy..."
dialogues.text: "Creepy..."

dialogues.jp:
頭をかいてから髪をかきあげて、音夢の額に頭
をよせる。
dialogues.en:
I scratch my head, fix my hair, and get closer to her
forehead.
dialogues.text:
I scratch my head, fix my hair, and get closer to her
forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Niisan..."
dialogues.text: "Niisan..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「行ってらっしゃい」
dialogues.en: "Have fun at school."
dialogues.text: "Have fun at school."

dialogues.jp:
ふっ、と音夢の顔が逸れて、頬に柔らかい感触
が残る。
dialogues.en: I feel the warmth on my cheek when she moves her face.
dialogues.text: I feel the warmth on my cheek when she moves her face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへへ♪　行ってらっしゃい」
dialogues.en: "Teehee... See you later."
dialogues.text: "Teehee... See you later."

dialogues.jp: くるり、と回って音夢が笑う。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiles and turns around.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiles and turns around.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「目、覚めたでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Are you awake now?"
dialogues.text: "Are you awake now?"

dialogues.jp: 頬を真っ赤にしながら音夢が家の中に逃げ込む。
dialogues.en: Nemu dashes into the house, blushing.
dialogues.text: Nemu dashes into the house, blushing.

dialogues.jp: 「恥ずかしいならやるなっての」
dialogues.en: "Don't do it if you feel embarrassed."
dialogues.text: "Don't do it if you feel embarrassed."

dialogues.jp:
春風に吹かれて、唇の形にだけ冷たい感触が走
る。
dialogues.en:
In the spring breeze, only the cool feeling remains on my
lips.
dialogues.text:
In the spring breeze, only the cool feeling remains on my
lips.

dialogues.jp: 「行ってきますか」
dialogues.en: "I'm ready to go."
dialogues.text: "I'm ready to go."

dialogues.jp: と、さくらの家の前で動きをとめる。
dialogues.en: I stopped in front of Sakura's house.
dialogues.text: I stopped in front of Sakura's house.

dialogues.jp: 「おーい、さくら〜」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Sakura!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Sakura!"

dialogues.jp: 「返事がない。ただの屍のようだ」
dialogues.en: "No response. There must be a dead person in there."
dialogues.text: "No response. There must be a dead person in there."

dialogues.jp: 「寒い」
dialogues.en: "It's cold."
dialogues.text: "It's cold."

dialogues.jp:
朝からハイブリッドなギャグに自分で突っ込み
つつ、俺はてろてろ、と先ほどよりも鈍い歩調
で戦場に向かった。
dialogues.en:
I walk toward the battlefield at a slower pace than before,
cracking my own jokes in the morning.
dialogues.text:
I walk toward the battlefield at a slower pace than before,
cracking my own jokes in the morning.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "Tired..."
dialogues.text: "Tired..."

dialogues.jp: なのに、振り返った。
dialogues.en: Nevertheless, I still look back.
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, I still look back.

dialogues.jp:
自分でも驚いたけれど、俺はさくらの家に向かっ
て振り返っていた。
dialogues.en: Surprisingly I still look back toward Sakura's house.
dialogues.text: Surprisingly I still look back toward Sakura's house.

dialogues.jp:
６年前にも感じた、なんとも言えない人気のな
い空気。
dialogues.en:
The air gives me the same deserted feeling that I had six
years ago.
dialogues.text:
The air gives me the same deserted feeling that I had six
years ago.

dialogues.jp: あいつはどこに行ってしまったのか。
dialogues.en: I wonder where she went.
dialogues.text: I wonder where she went.

dialogues.jp:
あの日の夜を境に、なにもかもが無理やり日常
を取り戻そうと働いたような気がする。
dialogues.en:
Since that night, I have been trying to get the normality
back in my life.
dialogues.text:
Since that night, I have been trying to get the normality
back in my life.

dialogues.jp: けれど、そこにはさくらも音夢もいない。
dialogues.en: But Sakura and Nemu aren't where they should be.
dialogues.text: But Sakura and Nemu aren't where they should be.

dialogues.jp:
当たり前ってやつの力で、俺はいつものように
学校に通って授業を受けようとする。
dialogues.en:
Trying to think that I asked for it, I go to school to study
as before.
dialogues.text:
Trying to think that I asked for it, I go to school to study
as before.

dialogues.jp:
１週間もすれば、本当に慣れてしまいそうで
……。
dialogues.en: I hope I get used to this in a week or so.
dialogues.text: I hope I get used to this in a week or so.

dialogues.jp: 怖かった。
dialogues.en: I'm scared.
dialogues.text: I'm scared.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "Tired..."
dialogues.text: "Tired..."

dialogues.jp:
少しだけ後ろ向きに歩いたあと、俺は頭をかい
てだらだらと登校することにした。
dialogues.en:
I walk backwards for a while, then decide to plod along to
school, scratching my head.
dialogues.text:
I walk backwards for a while, then decide to plod along to
school, scratching my head.

dialogues.jp:
背中に、まだ、俺達の笑い声が木霊して聞こえ
てくるような気がするのだ。
dialogues.en: I feel like I can hear an echo of our laughs.
dialogues.text: I feel like I can hear an echo of our laughs.

dialogues.jp: 幼い頃の――楽しい笑い声が。
dialogues.en: Happy laughs when we were younger.
dialogues.text: Happy laughs when we were younger.

dialogues.en: "Here you go..."
dialogues.text: "Here you go..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「またお前と一緒になったな。友よ」
dialogues.en: "We're in the same class again, my friend."
dialogues.text: "We're in the same class again, my friend."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「これは神の試練か？」
dialogues.en: "Is this an act of God or what?"
dialogues.text: "Is this an act of God or what?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお！　そんなに喜んでくれるか！　俺は嬉
　しいぞ」
dialogues.en: "Oh! I'm so glad you're happy!"
dialogues.text: "Oh! I'm so glad you're happy!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……どこをどうやったら、そんな解釈が出て
　くるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Where did you get that impression from?"
dialogues.text: "Where did you get that impression from?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「無論、皮肉だ」
dialogues.en: "Of course, it's sarcasm."
dialogues.text: "Of course, it's sarcasm."

dialogues.jp:
頭を抱えながら、俺はクラス替えのリストを作っ
た講師を呪った。
dialogues.en: I curse the teacher who made the class list.
dialogues.text: I curse the teacher who made the class list.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ま、同じクラスになってしまったからには仕
　方ない。これからまた１年、よろしく頼むぞ、
　朝倉」
dialogues.en:
"Well, what else can we do? Let's have a good year,
Asakura."
dialogues.text:
"Well, what else can we do? Let's have a good year,
Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「無理やりだがな」
dialogues.en: "I guess I've got no choice."
dialogues.text: "I guess I've got no choice."

dialogues.jp:
杉並はそのまま、俺の前の席にどっかり座り込
む。
dialogues.en: Suginami settles into the chair right in front of me.
dialogues.text: Suginami settles into the chair right in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
席順がまだ決まっていないので、ＨＲが始まる
までは、めいめい好きな所に座るしかない。
dialogues.en: We can sit anywhere we want until the seat layout's set.
dialogues.text: We can sit anywhere we want until the seat layout's set.

dialogues.jp:
教室の中には早くもグループが出来ていて、色
んな音の混じり合った雑音を生み出している。
dialogues.en:
People are already divided into groups, making different
kinds of noises.
dialogues.text:
People are already divided into groups, making different
kinds of noises.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「しかし、ついに今年は白河とも一緒のクラス
　か」
dialogues.en: "I am finally in the same class as Shirakawa this year."
dialogues.text: "I am finally in the same class as Shirakawa this year."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Hm."
dialogues.text: "Hm."

dialogues.jp:
杉並の視線を追うと、確かに、クラスの雰囲気
を一点に集めている学園のアイドルがいた。
dialogues.en:
Following Suginami's glance, there's the person who gets all
the attention in the class.
dialogues.text:
Following Suginami's glance, there's the person who gets all
the attention in the class.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁな。お前としても、ことりじゃちょっか
　いは出しづらいわな」
dialogues.en: "Well, I know it's hard for you to make a pass at Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Well, I know it's hard for you to make a pass at Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まぁな……水越や朝倉妹がいればよかったん
　だが」
dialogues.en: "I wish Mizukoshi and your sister were here."
dialogues.text: "I wish Mizukoshi and your sister were here."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな」
dialogues.en: "I know that."
dialogues.text: "I know that."

dialogues.jp:
ちらっ、と杉並を見るが、音夢の話題を出した
ことに関して特に反応はない。
dialogues.en:
I give a quick glance at Suginami, but he doesn't seem to
care about the topic of Nemu.
dialogues.text:
I give a quick glance at Suginami, but he doesn't seem to
care about the topic of Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
多分、こいつが一番音夢のことを考えてやって
いるんだろう。
dialogues.en: I know he's the one who is thinking of her most.
dialogues.text: I know he's the one who is thinking of her most.

dialogues.jp:
純粋に、音夢が学園に来れればいいと思ってい
るのだ。
dialogues.en: He just wants her back in this school.
dialogues.text: He just wants her back in this school.

dialogues.jp: 「動機が不純だがな」
dialogues.en: "Although your motive is not pure."
dialogues.text: "Although your motive is not pure."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なにがだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、また｛・・／学校｝が始まっちまったなってな」
dialogues.en: "I mean, I was just saying school's started again."
dialogues.text: "I mean, I was just saying school's started again."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、新しい講師が入ったって噂、知っ
　てるか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you hear about the new teacher?"
dialogues.text: "Did you hear about the new teacher?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「またか……」
dialogues.en: "Another one?"
dialogues.text: "Another one?"

dialogues.jp:
通常なら嬉しい話題なのだろうが、風見学園の
講師には現役研究者が登用されるので、変人が
多いのだ。
dialogues.en:
Usually that would be happy news. But many teachers at
Kazami Academy are active researchers, so they're kind of
weird.
dialogues.text:
Usually that would be happy news. But many teachers at
Kazami Academy are active researchers, so they're kind of
weird.

dialogues.jp:
「杉並の暴走を止められるレベルのやつなら、
　いいんだがな……」
dialogues.en:
"It would be great if they have the guts to keep Suginami in
check."
dialogues.text:
"It would be great if they have the guts to keep Suginami in
check."

dialogues.jp: ぼそり、と口の中で言葉をかみつぶす。
dialogues.en: I speak ambiguously.
dialogues.text: I speak ambiguously.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、バナナの皮と黒板消しとバケツ
　を用意したが、お前なら挨拶はどれにする？」
dialogues.en:
"In the meantime, I have a banana peel, a blackboard eraser
and a bucket. Which one would make the best greeting?"
dialogues.text:
"In the meantime, I have a banana peel, a blackboard eraser
and a bucket. Which one would make the best greeting?"

dialogues.jp: 当人はいたって楽しそうに笑っている。
dialogues.en: He smiles happily.
dialogues.text: He smiles happily.

dialogues.jp:
「マンガの中の悪ガキかお前は……だいたい、
　その話は本当なのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Are you trying to be an unruly student from a comic book?
First of all, is the story you told me true?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you trying to be an unruly student from a comic book?
First of all, is the story you told me true?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「信頼できる筋からの情報だ」
dialogues.en: "It's authentic information."
dialogues.text: "It's authentic information."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……誰だよそいつは」
dialogues.en: "Who told you that?"
dialogues.text: "Who told you that?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふっ……この学園の人間ではない」
dialogues.en: "Well... he's not a student in this school."
dialogues.text: "Well... he's not a student in this school."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「信用できねぇじゃねーか！」
dialogues.en: "Then, you can't trust him!"
dialogues.text: "Then, you can't trust him!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前は大佐の情報網を信頼できないのか？」
dialogues.en: "You don't trust a captain's intelligence network, do you?"
dialogues.text: "You don't trust a captain's intelligence network, do you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「誰だよそいつは？」
dialogues.en: "Who's that guy?"
dialogues.text: "Who's that guy?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「軍の情報部に籍をおいているらしく、可愛い
　女学生をチェックすることを趣味とする方だ
　が？」
dialogues.en:
"He belongs to a military intelligence bureau, and his hobby
is checking out pretty girls."
dialogues.text:
"He belongs to a military intelligence bureau, and his hobby
is checking out pretty girls."

dialogues.jp:
こいつとの会話も久しぶりだが、あいも変わら
ず疲れる。
dialogues.en:
It's been a while since I had a conversation with him, but
it's still tiring to be with him.
dialogues.text:
It's been a while since I had a conversation with him, but
it's still tiring to be with him.

dialogues.jp:
本来なら、この辺りで音夢の突っ込みが炸裂す
るのだが……。
dialogues.en: Usually I'd be expecting Nemu's joke just about now.
dialogues.text: Usually I'd be expecting Nemu's joke just about now.

dialogues.jp: ガラガラ──
dialogues.en: Rattle...
dialogues.text: Rattle...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい。どこでもいいから席着いてー。ホー
　ムルーム始めるよー」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, everyone. Have a seat wherever you want. Let's start
the homeroom."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, everyone. Have a seat wherever you want. Let's start
the homeroom."

dialogues.jp:
聞きなれた声に顔を上げると、見慣れた講師が
そこにいた。
dialogues.en:
I lift my head when I hear the familiar voice, to see a
teacher I've seen before.
dialogues.text:
I lift my head when I hear the familiar voice, to see a
teacher I've seen before.

dialogues.jp: （……って、また暦先生が担任なのか）
dialogues.en: (Koyomi-sensei's our classroom teacher again, huh.)
dialogues.text: (Koyomi-sensei's our classroom teacher again, huh.)

dialogues.jp:
ことりといい杉並といい、知った顔がそれなり
に多いな。
dialogues.en:
I recognize quite a few faces, including Kotori and
Suginami.
dialogues.text:
I recognize quite a few faces, including Kotori and
Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
と、ふと視線を感じた。顔を巡らせると、こと
りが小さく手を振っていた。
dialogues.en:
I feel someone's eye on me, so I turn and see Kotori waving
at me quietly.
dialogues.text:
I feel someone's eye on me, so I turn and see Kotori waving
at me quietly.

dialogues.jp: それに軽く手を振って応える。
dialogues.en: I wave back to her.
dialogues.text: I wave back to her.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい、それじゃ、とりあえず出欠を取ろ
　うと思うのだが――」
dialogues.en: "Okay, everyone. I'll have a roll call now."
dialogues.text: "Okay, everyone. I'll have a roll call now."

dialogues.jp: 含みを持たせて暦先生がほくそ笑む。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei smiles meaningfully.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei smiles meaningfully.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「実は、君たちの担任は私じゃないんだ」
dialogues.en: "As a matter of fact, I'm not your teacher this year."
dialogues.text: "As a matter of fact, I'm not your teacher this year."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Oh?"
dialogues.text: "Oh?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並に目を向けると、奴は薬指をくるくる回し
て、それを上下に振っていた。
dialogues.en:
When I looked at Suginami, he was spinning his fourth finger
up and down.
dialogues.text:
When I looked at Suginami, he was spinning his fourth finger
up and down.

dialogues.jp: なんのジェスチャーだか全然分からねぇよ……。
dialogues.en: I have no idea what that gesture means.
dialogues.text: I have no idea what that gesture means.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと突然の就任で、紹介が本人からになっ
　てしまったが、まぁ、お互いにがんばってく
　れ」
dialogues.en:
"She's a new teacher in this school, so I'll introduce her
now. But good luck to you."
dialogues.text:
"She's a new teacher in this school, so I'll introduce her
now. But good luck to you."

dialogues.jp: と、廊下に向かって暦先生が頷く。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei nods toward the hallway.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei nods toward the hallway.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、誰になったところで――！？」
dialogues.en: "Well, whoever becomes our teacher..."
dialogues.text: "Well, whoever becomes our teacher..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「こんちゃーす♪」
dialogues.en: "Hello!"
dialogues.text: "Hello!"

dialogues.jp: ピシィ！！
dialogues.en: Bang!!
dialogues.text: Bang!!

dialogues.jp: ――そして時は動き出す。

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、色々とあるだろうが宜しく――」
dialogues.en: Time starts ticking once again.
dialogues.text: Time starts ticking once again.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て〜！！」
dialogues.en: "Good luck to you, everyone."
dialogues.text: "Good luck to you, everyone."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うるさい学生ですね」
dialogues.en: "Wait a second!"
dialogues.text: "Wait a second!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "You, quiet!"
dialogues.text: "You, quiet!"

dialogues.jp: 席を立ったまま、半眼でさくらを｛にら／睨｝む。

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おネ……じゃなかった、先生、これは？」
dialogues.en: "Onee? I mean, sensei, what's going on?"
dialogues.text: "Onee? I mean, sensei, what's going on?"

dialogues.jp: ことりが小さく手を挙げて呟く。
dialogues.en: Kotori asks, raising her hand quietly.
dialogues.text: Kotori asks, raising her hand quietly.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「言った通り、彼女が新しい講師だ」
dialogues.en: "As I told you, she's the new teacher for this class."
dialogues.text: "As I told you, she's the new teacher for this class."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待ってください……」
dialogues.en: "Hold on a second."
dialogues.text: "Hold on a second."

dialogues.jp: あぁ、本気で頭痛がしてきた。
dialogues.en: Oh, God... I have a headache now.
dialogues.text: Oh, God... I have a headache now.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、皆が驚くのも無理はないが、彼女の適
　正に関しては折り紙つきだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I don't blame you all for being surprised, but I
guarantee you she is a very good teacher."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I don't blame you all for being surprised, but I
guarantee you she is a very good teacher."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ＩＱ１８０。すでにアメリカで大学も卒業し
　て、生物工学の博士号を取得している」
dialogues.en:
"Her IQ is 180 and she has a Ph.D in bioengineering from a
university in America."
dialogues.text:
"Her IQ is 180 and she has a Ph.D in bioengineering from a
university in America."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「特に植物に関する特許をいくつも持っている
　から、将来の長者番付候補でもある」
dialogues.en:
"And she owns many patents in plants, so she will be on the
billionaires list someday."
dialogues.text:
"And she owns many patents in plants, so she will be on the
billionaires list someday."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、簡単に言って、世界中の君らと同世代
　の中でも掛け値なしの天才ってことだ」
dialogues.en: "Basically she's one of those geniuses in the world."
dialogues.text: "Basically she's one of those geniuses in the world."

dialogues.jp: はい？
dialogues.en: What?
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.jp:
耳というのか、俺の精神がおかしくなってしまっ
たようだ。
dialogues.en: I think my head broke down, not my hearing.
dialogues.text: I think my head broke down, not my hearing.

dialogues.jp: もしくは、さくらのそっくりさんだろうか。
dialogues.en: Is she Sakura's look-alike?
dialogues.text: Is she Sakura's look-alike?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「とにかく、本来は向こうでも国外に手放した
　くないくらいの人材だが事情があって一時的
　に風見学園の講師に籍をおいてくれたんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Actually she's in great demand over there, but she agreed
to teach at Kazami Academy temporarily for reasons of her
own."
dialogues.text:
"Actually she's in great demand over there, but she agreed
to teach at Kazami Academy temporarily for reasons of her
own."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いやぁ、そんなたいしたことないですよ〜」
dialogues.en: "I'm not as special as she says."
dialogues.text: "I'm not as special as she says."

dialogues.jp:
どんな謙遜も嫌味にしかならない経歴だろうが、
あいつが言うと本当にたいしたことなさそうに
聞こえる。
dialogues.en:
How modestly she speaks about her successful career. It's
supposed to sound like modesty, but in her case, we can
believe what she says.
dialogues.text:
How modestly she speaks about her successful career. It's
supposed to sound like modesty, but in her case, we can
believe what she says.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ボク、芳乃さくらと申します。不束者で
　短い間だとは思いますが、皆様宜しくお願い
　しますにゃ〜♪」
dialogues.en:
"My name is Sakura Yoshino. I'm an inexperienced teacher,
but I'll do my best. I'd like to have a good time with you
even for a short period of time."
dialogues.text:
"My name is Sakura Yoshino. I'm an inexperienced teacher,
but I'll do my best. I'd like to have a good time with you
even for a short period of time."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほぉ……にゃ〜、とはポイントが高い」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... She gets a high score."
dialogues.text: "Hmm... She gets a high score."

dialogues.jp:
ただ一人を除いて、クラスの人間全員が凍りつ
いたのは言うまでもあるまい……。
dialogues.en:
Needless to say, everyone's stunned except one person in the
class.
dialogues.text:
Needless to say, everyone's stunned except one person in the
class.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくら先生・見参◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura-sensei's new class◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura-sensei's new class◆

dialogues.jp:
夢と同じように、さくらの家には人気がなかっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Like in a dream I had, I don't sense anybody in Sakura's
house.
dialogues.text:
Like in a dream I had, I don't sense anybody in Sakura's
house.

dialogues.jp:
登校した学園では、今度はことりと杉並がクラ
スメイトとなった。
dialogues.en:
At a new school, I was in the same class as Kotori and
Suginami.
dialogues.text:
At a new school, I was in the same class as Kotori and
Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
ため息と歓声を上げる配置だったが、新しく赴
任したという講師がさくらで、俺は｛あぜん／唖然｝とする
しかなかった。
dialogues.en:
Lots of sighs and cheers were flying around in the
classroom, but when I found out the new teacher was Sakura,
I was absolutely dumbfounded.
dialogues.text:
Lots of sighs and cheers were flying around in the
classroom, but when I found out the new teacher was Sakura,
I was absolutely dumbfounded.
